item: Edge box: cameras per box (bay @ 1 fps), conservative
assumptions: PROXY ESTIMATE: 16 cameras measured on RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell (4 worker thread(s)) x 0.21 (conservative) / x 0.33 (optimistic). RTX 4060 Ti/RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell: FP32 ratio 0.33, memory-bandwidth ratio 0.21; conservative = min, optimistic = max. Assumes the pipeline is GPU-bound; CPU-side Python work does not scale with the GPU. The 4060 Ti itself was not measured; one pipeline instance held 19472.0 MiB of GPU memory on the box (4060 Ti: 8 or 16 GB), which also caps the number of workers.
